notes.title: The Name of the game is changing slightly
notes.notes: Hello everyone the name of the game: Lucky Tlhalerwa - IMS Death Squad is changing to Lucky Pikinini - IMS Death Squad. that is the only change, nothing else, this does not change anything else in the game.

notes.title: NEW IMS DEATH SQUAD BUILD HAS GONE LIVE, UPDATE YOUR GAME TO THE LATEST BUILD
notes.notes:
This is the Survival Mode build which introduces  more than 7 survival maps and multiple fixes to the story mode.

These fixes include new files taken from the latest game in development IMS Intelligence Corp,
Healing Gun L-22s bandages now rolls as your healing and has motor sounds, bomb and medikit models have been updated with new models made for Intelligence Corp game, etc. Survival mode includes many maps from cybernetic titan

notes.title: FUTURE PROJECTS ROADMAP & 5 DAYS UNTIL IMS DEATH SQUAD IS CHARGED $1.99
notes.notes:
Final chance to get IMS Death Squad for FREE, 10,000 people have so far claimed it and over 1,000 have played despite only a few reviews on the STEAM store page. The game will continue to receive updates, fixing minor bugs and issues. The game is planned to be charged a mere $1.99, with regular 50% sales which means you'll be able to get for $0.99 from time to time, the $1.99 price point is subject to change.

IMS Intelligence Corp is in active development and set to release somewhere around mid - 2023, after its development is finished it won't release straight away, Lightning & Force a new game series will enter development right after. The 2 games might release both at the same time. 

Voice acting for story characters is being introduced for the first time with IMS Intelligence Corp, the game play loop is being expanded with elevators, cargo lifts, trams, crawling through air vents, swimming, smart ai companion, new special weapons like flamethrowers, item crafting blueprints, upgrading your character ETC.

Heres a list of games planned to be developed in the near future including the ones already mentioned:

-IMS Intelligence Corp
Super incursion dlc covering whats the IMS Intelligence Corp team was doing in Operation: Winter strike and what they're fate was.
-Lightning & Force
A super hero-like game, where you control a voiced Female protagonist who can fly, shoot lightning and electric bolts. who is being hunted down and pursued by multiple governments.
-Earth Control
A super hero-like game, where you control a voiced Female protagonist who can control the ground, rocks, boulders, brick walls and soil. She can use it to make earth shields, create tall earth platforms to jump on and reach elevated areas etc.
-Zombie Rampage 2
A sequel to the existing original zombie rampage game, inheriting all previous games gameplay loop additions and fixes plus new ideas. inspiration from existing games in the AAA space will be drawn.
-Super Incursion 2
A direct sequel to the first super incursion, it comes after all the improvements in the IMS games have been established and it will build on top of them adding more features and ideas. it will resemble and play like IMS Intelligence Corp but far much better. John Jason will remain protagonist with Marcelene Grimes as partner, they will be both voiced.
-Urban Survival
An open-world realistic survival simulator based on surviving in a post-disaster abandoned deserted cargo ship construction and maintenance port city resembling one found in POLAND. where you pick your  gender and what tools you start off with. the development of the game has been put on hold for more money and game files to be made first, as a game of this scale is sheer and demanding and will take a long time to finish.

We are currently focusing more on smaller and shorter games to make to raise up money and create a community before we can justify making much longer and larger games.

notes.title: IMS Death Squad Is Totally FREE For First Month, Then $2.99 Afterwards
notes.notes: IMS Death Squad will be completely free for only the first month of release and will be priced $2.99 afterwards, Follow our Lucky Tlhalerwa steam page to be notified of new games and new content as we make 3 games every year, some big, some small. We appreciate any and all feedback on the game. As we plan to develop IMS Intelligence Corp, another super incursion standalone dlc. We will use feedback from IMS Death Squad to shape IMS Intelligence Corp.

notes.title: IMS Death Squad has been delayed
notes.notes:
IMS Death Squad has been delayed while we refine it, we've added a ton of new features including being able sprint and dive down on your back and shoot, there are 4 stances, standing, crouch, prone and backlay. you can sprint towards doors and mash "F" to burst through them causing alot of noise. We've added pushable objects which block paths. we've improved the graphical and environmental detail with new clocks, switch boards, wall plug sockets, wall light switches and more dirt. We've expanded the gameplay loop with click consoles and hold down consoles, we've removed horizontal ropes from the game entirely, they will return in future titles like IMS Intelligence Corp, We've created new animations and added new sound effects.

We apologise for the delay but we had to add all these things, plus now we are working on a massive ai enemy improvement, together with new ai enemy animations.
